Examples.Title: Generate asset upload urls
Examples.Description:
Generates a list of pre-signed upload URLs for the assets required. This API is only necessary if you want to upload to Magic Hour's storage. Refer to the [Input Files Guide](/integration/input-files) for more details.

The response array will match the order of items in the request body.

**Valid file extensions per asset type**:
- video: mp4, m4v, mov, webm
- audio: mp3, wav, aac, flac, webm, m4a, opus, ogg, aiff, amr
- image: png, jpg, jpeg, jfif, heic, heif, webp, avif, jp2, tiff, bmp
- gif: gif, webp, webm

> Note: `gif` is only supported for face swap API `video_file_path` field.

Once you receive an upload URL, send a `PUT` request to upload the file directly.

Example:

```
curl -X PUT --data '@/path/to/file/video.mp4' \
  https://videos.magichour.ai/api-assets/id/video.mp4?<auth params from the API response>
```
Examples.Code:
### Generate asset upload urls
# @name videoAssets.generatePresignedUrl
POST {{host}}/v1/files/upload-urls
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "items": [
    {
      "type": "video",
      "extension": "mp4"
    },
    {
      "type": "audio",
      "extension": "mp3"
    }
  ]
}

Examples.Title: Audio-to-Video
Examples.Description:
**What this API does**

Create the same Audio To Video you can make in the browser, but programmatically, so you can automate it, run it at scale, or connect it to your own app or workflow.
    
**Good for**
- Automation and batch processing  
- Adding audio to video into apps, pipelines, or tools  

**How it works (3 steps)**
1) Upload your inputs (video, image, or audio) with [Generate Upload URLs](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls) and copy the `file_path`.  
2) Send a request to create a audio to video job with the basic fields.  
3) Check the job status until it's `complete`, then download the result from `downloads`.

**Key options**
- Inputs: usually a file, sometimes a YouTube link, depending on project type  
- Resolution: free users are limited to 576px; higher plans unlock HD and larger sizes  
- Extra fields: e.g. `face_swap_mode`, `start_seconds`/`end_seconds`, or a text prompt  

**Cost**  
Credits are only charged for the frames that actually render. You'll see an estimate when the job is queued, and the final total after it's done.

For detailed examples, see the [product page](https://magichour.ai/products/audio-to-video).
Examples.Code:
### Audio-to-Video
# @name audioToVideo.createVideo
POST {{host}}/v1/audio-to-video
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "name": "My Audio To Video video",
  "start_seconds": 0,
  "end_seconds": 15,
  "resolution": "720p",
  "assets": {
    "audio_file_path": "api-assets/id/1234.mp3",
    "image_file_path": "api-assets/id/1234.png"
  },
  "style": {
    "prompt": "Car driving through a city"

}

Examples.Title: Get video details
Examples.Description:
Check the progress of a video project. The `downloads` field is populated after a successful render.
  
**Statuses**
- `queued` — waiting to start
- `rendering` — in progress
- `complete` — ready; see `downloads`
- `error` — a failure occurred (see `error`)
- `canceled` — user canceled
- `draft` — not used
Examples.Code:
### Get video details
# @name videoProjects.getDetails
GET {{host}}/v1/video-projects/{{id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Accept: application/json
